findings.motion: HB 304, voter whose ID shows no proof of citizenship was given to the state: coauthor (committee report sent to Calendars 2025-04-23)
findings.note: She is a House coauthor of HB 304. The bill sets the procedure for accepting a voter whose driver's license or ID card shows the voter has not given the state proof of U.S. citizenship. The bill history shows the committee report sent to the calendar on 2025-04-23.

findings.motion: HB 1670, proof of citizenship to verify eligibility to vote: coauthor (referred to Elections committee 2025-03-12)
findings.note: She is a House coauthor of HB 1670, relating to a person submitting proof of citizenship to verify eligibility to vote in Texas. The bill was referred to committee on 2025-03-12.

findings.motion: SJR 37, constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen: adopted by the House, Record 2196, 102 yeas, 14 nays, 22 present not voting
findings.note: The House Journal lists Holt among the yeas on final House adoption of SJR 37, the proposed amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen.
